japanese: これは猫だ。
reading: これはねこだ。

meanings.en: This is a cat.

japanese: 私は日本人だ。
reading: わたしはにほんじんだ。

meanings.en: I am Japanese.

japanese: 私が日本人だ。
reading: わたしがにほんじんだ。

meanings.en: I am the one who is Japanese. / I am Japanese.

japanese: これは私の猫だ。
reading: これはわたしのねこだ。

meanings.en: This is my cat.

japanese: 猫は黒い。
reading: ねこはくろい。

meanings.en: Cats are black. / The cat is black.

japanese: 黒い猫を見る。
reading: くろいねこをみる。

meanings.en: I see a black cat.

japanese: りんごは緑。
reading: りんごはみどり。

meanings.en: Apples are green. / The apple is green.

japanese: 緑のりんごを食べる。
reading: みどりのりんごをたべる。

meanings.en: I eat a green apple.

japanese: 黒い猫に緑のりんごをあげる。
reading: くろいねこにみどりのりんごをあげる。

meanings.en: I give a green apple to a black cat.

japanese: 猫は水と牛乳を飲む。
reading: ねこはみずとぎゅうにゅうをのむ。

meanings.en: The cat drinks water and milk.

japanese: 猫と遊びたい。
reading: ねことあそびたい。

meanings.en: I want to play with the cat.

japanese: 日曜日に母とお茶を飲む。
reading: にちようびにははとおちゃをのむ。

meanings.en: On Sunday, I drink tea with my mother.

japanese: 黒い猫がいる。
reading: わたしにはくろいねこがいる。

meanings.en: I have a black cat.

japanese: お茶がある。
reading: おちゃがある。

meanings.en: I have tea. / There is tea.

japanese: 月曜日にサッカーをして、本を読んで、ラーメンを食べる。
reading: げつようびにさっかーをして、ほんをよんで、らーめんをたべる。

meanings.en: On Monday, I play football, read a book, and eat ramen.

japanese: 弟も月曜日にお茶を飲む。
reading: おとうともげつようびにおちゃをのむ。

meanings.en: My younger brother also drinks tea on Monday.

japanese: 弟は日本から来た。
reading: おとうとはにほんからきた。

meanings.en: My younger brother comes from Japan.

japanese: あなたの弟は日本人だの？
reading: あなたのおとうとはにほんじんだの？

meanings.en: Is your younger brother Japanese?

japanese: あなたの弟は日本人ですか？
reading: あなたのおとうとはにほんじんですか？

meanings.en: Is your younger brother Japanese?

japanese: 弟は日本人だよ。
reading: おとうとはにほんじんだよ。

meanings.en: My younger brother is Japanese.

japanese: これは友だちの犬だ。
reading: これはともだちのいぬだ。

meanings.en: This is my friend's dog.

japanese: 友だちは「こんにちは」と言う。
reading: ともだちは「こんにちは」という。

meanings.en: My friend says "hello."

japanese: 学校に本がある。
reading: がっこうにほんがある。

meanings.en: There is a book at school.

japanese: 学校で学生が話す。
reading: がっこうでがくせいがはなす。

meanings.en: Students talk at school.

japanese: 山に行きたい。
reading: やまにいきたい。

meanings.en: I want to go to the mountains.

japanese: 山へ行きたい。
reading: やまへいきたい。

meanings.en: I want to go to the mountains.

japanese: 山が好き。
reading: やまがすき。

meanings.en: I like mountains.

japanese: 山が大好き。
reading: やまがだいすき。

meanings.en: I love mountains.

japanese: パンケーキ。テイータイム。

meanings.en: Pancakes. It’s tea time.

notes: Word/particle analysis: ンケーキ: pancake | テイータイム: tea time

japanese: マミピッグから嬉しいサプライズです。

meanings.en: It's a pleasant surprise from Mummy Pig.

notes: Word/particle analysis: マミピッグ: Mummy Pig | から: particle indicating the source ("from") | 嬉しい: pleasant | サプライズ: noun (loanword, "surprise") | です: polite copula

japanese: 今日はパンケーキを作るわね。

meanings.en: Today we’ll make pancakes.

notes: Word/particle analysis: 今日: today | は: topic particle | パンケーキ: pancake | を: object particle | 作る: to make | わ: feminine sentence-ending particle | ね: sentence-ending particle seeking agreement

japanese: パンケーキか、美味しいんだよな。

meanings.en: Pancakes! That’s delicious!

notes: Word/particle analysis: パンケーキ: pancake | か: sentence-ending particle expressing realization or reflection | 美味しい: delicious | ん: explanatory の | だ: explanatory copula | よ: sentence-ending particle adding emphasis | な: sentence-ending particle expressing reflection or agreement

japanese: パンケーキ大好き。

meanings.en: I love pancakes.

notes: Word/particle analysis: パンケーキ: pancake | 大好きな: loved

japanese: みんなパンケーキが大好きです。

meanings.en: Everyone love pancakes.

notes: Word/particle analysis: みんな: everyone | パンケーキ: pancake | が: subject particle | 大好きな: loved | です: polite suffix

japanese: パンケーキをひっくり返すのは得意なんだ。

meanings.en: I'm good at flipping pancakes.

notes: Word/particle analysis: パンケーキ: pancake | を: object particle | ひっくり返す: to flip over | の: nominalizer | は: topic particle | 得意な: good at, skilled | な: verb “だ” | んだ: explanatory の + だ

japanese: 任せておいて。

meanings.en: Leave it to me.

notes: Word/particle analysis: 任せて: te-form of 任せる, to leave to someone, to entrust | おいて: te-form of おく, “do in advance” or "leave it that way"

japanese: 本当に大丈夫？

meanings.en: Are you sure about it?

notes: Word/particle analysis: 本当に: adverb, really | 大丈夫な: okay, all right

japanese: この前はパンケーキを床に落としてイライラしてたけど。

meanings.en: But the other day, you dropped the pancake on the floor and got frustrated.

notes: Word/particle analysis: この前: the other day | は: topic particle | パンケーキ: pancake | を: object particle | 床: floor | に: particle indicating destination/location | 落として: te-form of 落とす, to drop | イライラしてた: was irritated, was frustrated | けど: conjunction meaning "but", often leaving the sentence unfinished

japanese: イライラなんかしてないよ。

meanings.en: I wasn't frustrated at all!

notes: Word/particle analysis: イライラ: irritation, frustration | なんか: particle adding emphasis, "or anything like that", “at all” | してない: contracted form of していない, "not doing", "not being" | よ: sentence-ending particle adding emphasis

japanese: フライパンの調子が悪かったんだ。

meanings.en: It was a bad frying pan.

notes: Word/particle analysis: フライパン: frying pan | の: possessive particle | 調子: condition, state | が: subject particle | 悪かった: i-adjective (past), was bad | んだ: explanatory の + だ

japanese: マミー、パンケーキ作るのお手伝いしてもいい？

meanings.en: Mummy, may I help make the pancakes?

notes: Word/particle analysis: マミー: Mummy | パンケーキ: pancake | 作る: to make | の: nominalizer | お: honorific prefix | 手伝いして: te-form of the verb to help: お手伝いする | もいい: is it okay if I do, may I

japanese: それじゃあ、一緒に生地を作りましょう。

meanings.en: Well then, let's make the dough together.

notes: Word/particle analysis: それじゃあ: well then | 一緒: together | に: adverbial particle | 生地: dough | を: object particle | 作りましょう: volitional polite form of 作る, let's make

japanese: まず、ボールに小麦粉を入れるわね。

meanings.en: First, we'll put the flour into the bowl.

notes: Word/particle analysis: まず: first | ボール: bowl | に: particle indicating destination | 小麦粉: flour | を: object particle | 入れる: to put in | わ: feminine sentence-ending particle | ね: sentence-ending particle seeking agreement

japanese: 次に卵。

meanings.en: Next, the eggs.

notes: Word/particle analysis: 次に: next | 卵: egg

japanese: 牛乳を入れて。

meanings.en: We add the milk.

notes: Word/particle analysis: 牛乳: milk | を: object particle | 入れて: te-form of 入れる, to add, to put in

japanese: よーくかき混ぜるの。

meanings.en: We mix it well.

notes: Word/particle analysis: よーく: thoroughly, well | かき混ぜる: to stir, to mix thoroughly | の: particle giving a soft explanatory/instructional tone

japanese: マミー、かき混ぜていい？

meanings.en: Mommy, can I stir it?

notes: Word/particle analysis: マミー: Mommy | かき混ぜて: te-form of かき混ぜる, to stir, to mix | いい: i-adjective, good; in ～ていい, "may / is it okay to"

japanese: ええ、良いわよ、ペッパ。

meanings.en: Yes, you can, Peppa.

notes: Word/particle analysis: ええ: yes, sure | 良い: i-adjective, good, okay | わ: feminine sentence-ending particle | よ: sentence-ending particle adding emphasis | ペッパ: Peppa

japanese: ペッパはかき混ぜるのが大好き。

meanings.en: Peppa loves stirring.

notes: Word/particle analysis: ペッパ: Peppa | は: topic particle | かき混ぜる: to stir, to mix | の: nominalizer | が: subject particle | 大好き: na-adjective, love, be very fond of

japanese: ジョージもかき混ぜたいようです。

meanings.en: It seems George wants to stir too.

notes: Word/particle analysis: ジョージ: George | も: particle meaning "also, too" | かき混ぜたい: want to stir, want to mix | よう: seems, appears | です: polite copula

japanese: ジョージ、こうやるのよ。

meanings.en: George, this is how you do it.

notes: Word/particle analysis: ジョージ: George | こう: like this, this way | やる: to do | の: explanatory sentence-ending particle | よ: sentence-ending particle adding emphasis

japanese: はーい、それぐらいで良いわよ。

meanings.en: Okay, that's enough.

notes: Word/particle analysis: はい: okay, yes | それぐらい: about that much, that's enough | で: particle indicating an acceptable amount/state, "with that" | 良い: i-adjective, good, fine | わ: feminine sentence-ending particle | よ: sentence-ending particle adding emphasis

japanese: マミーがパンケーキを焼くから座って待っててね。

meanings.en: Mommy will cook the pancakes, so sit down and wait, okay?

notes: Word/particle analysis: マミー: Mommy | が: subject particle | パンケーキ: pancake | を: object particle | 焼く: to cook, to fry | から: because, since | 座って: te-form of 座る, to sit | 待ってて: contracted form of 待っていて, wait, keep waiting | ね: sentence-ending particle adding a soft, friendly tone

japanese: マミーピッグがパンケーキをひっくり返します。/// すごーい！

meanings.en: Mummy Pig flips the pancake. /// Amazing!

notes: Word/particle analysis: マミーピッグ: Mummy Pig | が: subject particle | パンケーキ: pancake | を: object particle | ひっくり返します: to flip over, polite form of ひっくり返す | すごい: i-adjective, amazing, awesome

japanese: もっと高く放りあげなきゃ。

meanings.en: You’ve got to toss it higher.

notes: Word/particle analysis: もっと: more, further | 高く: i-adjective adverbial form of 高い, high → highly | 放りあげなきゃ: contraction of 放り上げなければ, must toss up

japanese: じゃあ、自分の分を焼くときにやって見せて、ダディーピッグ。

meanings.en: Then show us when you cook your own, Daddy Pig.

notes: Word/particle analysis: じゃあ: then, well then | 自分: oneself, one's own | の: possessive particle | 分: share, portion | を: object particle | 焼く: to cook, to fry | とき: when | に: particle indicating the occasion/time | やって: te-form of やる, to do | 見せて: te-form of 見せる, to show | ダディーピッグ: Daddy Pig

japanese: 1枚目はジョージの分。

meanings.en: The first one is for George.

notes: Word/particle analysis: 1枚目: the first one | は: topic particle | ジョージ: George | の: possessive particle | 分: share, portion

japanese: マミーピッグがパンケーキにシロップを掛けます。

meanings.en: Mummy Pig pours syrup over the pancake.

notes: Word/particle analysis: マミーピッグ: Mummy Pig | が: subject particle | パンケーキ: pancake | に: particle indicating the target | シロップ: syrup | を: object particle | 掛ける: to pour over, to drizzle

japanese: 美味しいね。

meanings.en: It's delicious, isn't it?

notes: Word/particle analysis: 美味しい: i-adjective, delicious | ね: sentence-ending particle seeking agreement

japanese: これはペッパの分です。/// すごーい！

meanings.en: This one is for Peppa. /// Awesome.

notes: Word/particle analysis: これ: this | は: topic particle | ペッパ: Peppa | の: possessive particle | 分: share, portion | です: polite copula

japanese: うーん、もうちょっと高く放り上げないと。

meanings.en: Hmm, you need to toss it a little higher.

notes: Word/particle analysis: うーん: hmm | もうちょっと: a little more | 高く: i-adjective adverbial form of 高い, higher | 放り上げない: negative form of 放り上げる, not toss up | と: conditional particle; ～ないと implies “have to / must”

japanese: だったら、自分の分を焼くときにやって見せてちょうだい、ダディーピッグ。

meanings.en: In that case, show us when you cook your own one, Daddy Pig.

notes: Word/particle analysis: だったら: if so, in that case | 自分: oneself, one's own | の: possessive particle | 分: share, portion | を: object particle | 焼く: to cook, to fry | とき: when | に: particle indicating the occasion | やって: te-form of やる, to do | 見せて: te-form of 見せる, to show | ちょうだい: please, used to make a request | ダディーピッグ: Daddy Pig

japanese: シロップ掛けて。

meanings.en: Pour some syrup on it.

notes: Word/particle analysis: シロップ: syrup | 掛けて: to pour over, to drizzle

japanese: うーん、美味しい。

meanings.en: Mmm, delicious.

notes: Word/particle analysis: うーん: mmm | 美味しい: i-adjective, delicious

japanese: これはマミーピッグの分。/// すごーい！

meanings.en: This one Mummy Pig’s pancake. /// Amazing!

notes: Word/particle analysis: これ: this | は: topic particle | マミーピッグ: Mummy Pig | の: possessive particle | 分: share, portion | すごい: i-adjective, amazing, awesome

japanese: まだまだ、もうちょっと高く放り上げなきゃ。

meanings.en: Not quite, you need to toss it a little higher.

notes: Word/particle analysis: まだまだ: not yet, still not enough | もうちょっと: a little more | 高く: i-adjective adverbial form of 高い, higher | 放り上げなきゃ: contraction of 放り上げなければ, must toss up

japanese: 次はダディーピッグの分だから、どうやれば良いのか、やって見せてちょうだい。

meanings.en: The next one is Daddy Pig's, so please show us how to do it.

notes: Word/particle analysis: 次: next | は: topic particle | ダディーピッグ: Daddy Pig | の: possessive particle | 分: share, portion | だ: plain copula | から: because, since | どう: how | やれば: conditional form of やる, if one does | 良い: i-adjective, good | の: explanatory nominalizer | か: question particle | やって: te-form of やる, to do | 見せて: to show | ちょうだい: please

japanese: うーん、とっても美味しい。

meanings.en: Mmm, it’s really delicious.

notes: Word/particle analysis: うーん: mmm | とっても: very, really | 美味しい: i-adjective, delicious

japanese: みんな良く見てろよ。

meanings.en: Everyone, watch carefully!

notes: Word/particle analysis: みんな: everyone | 良く: i-adjective adverbial form of 良い, well, carefully | 見てろ: contracted imperative of 見ていろ, watch, keep watching | よ: sentence-ending particle adding emphasis

japanese: パンケーキをひっくり返す時は、高ーく放り上げるのがコツだ。

meanings.en: The trick to flipping a pancake is to toss it really high.

notes: Word/particle analysis: パンケーキ: pancake | を: object particle | ひっくり返す: to flip over | 時: when | は: topic particle | 高ーく: i-adjective adverbial form of 高い, really high | 放り上げる: to toss up | の: nominalizer | が: subject particle | コツ: trick, knack | だ: plain copula

japanese: １、２の３、そーれ！ /// ダディーったら。

meanings.en: One, two, three... here we go! /// Oh, Daddy!

notes: Word/particle analysis: １: one | ２: two | の: linking particle used in the counting expression | ３: three | そーれ: there we go!, here goes! | ダディー: Daddy | ったら: particle expressing exasperation or affectionate reproach

japanese: あー、ちょっと高すぎたみたいだね。

meanings.en: Ah, looks like that was a little too high.

notes: Word/particle analysis: あー: ah | ちょっと: a little | 高い: i-adjective high | すぎた: was too (much) from すぎる | みたいな: na-adjective, seems, looks like | だ: plain copula | ね: sentence-ending particle seeking agreement

japanese: あらま、大変、最後のパンケーキだったのに。

meanings.en: Oh my! Oh no! And that was the last pancake.

notes: Word/particle analysis: あらま: oh my | 大変な: na-adjective, terrible, serious | 最後の: last | の: linking particle | パンケーキ: pancake | だった: past plain form of だ, was | のに: although, even though; expresses regret or disappointment

japanese: 取れば良いんだろ？ 取ればー。

meanings.en: I just have to get it, right? I would get it.

notes: Word/particle analysis: 取れば: conditional form of 取る, if I get/take it | 良い: i-adjective, good | ん: explanatory の | だろ: contraction of だろう, right?, I suppose | 取ればー: if I get/take it; repeated with emphasis

japanese: おやおや、パンケーキに手が届きません。

meanings.en: Oh dear, he can't reach the pancake.

notes: Word/particle analysis: おやおや: oh dear | パンケーキ: pancake | に: particle indicating the target | 手: hand | が: subject particle | 届く: to reach

japanese: 大丈夫よ、ダディーピッグ、私たちが取って上げる。

meanings.en: It's okay, Daddy Pig. We'll get it for you.

notes: Word/particle analysis: 大丈夫な: na-adjective, okay, all right | よ: sentence-ending particle adding emphasis | ダディーピッグ: Daddy Pig | 私たち: we, us | が: subject particle | 取って: to get, to take | 上げる: auxiliary meaning to do something for someone

japanese: さあ、２階に行きましょう。/// こっちよ。

meanings.en: Come on, let's go upstairs. /// This way.

notes: Word/particle analysis: さあ: come on, well then | 二階: second floor, upstairs | に: destination particle | 行きましょう: let's go | こっち: this way, over here | よ: sentence-ending particle adding emphasis

japanese: 一体何をするつもりなのでしょう？

meanings.en: What on earth are they planning to do?

notes: Word/particle analysis: 一体: what on earth | 何: what | を: object particle | する: to do | つもり: intention, plan | な: form of だ before の | の: explanatory particle | でしょう: polite form expressing conjecture, “I wonder”

japanese: じゃあいーい？１、２の３でみんな一緒に飛び跳ねるわよ。

meanings.en: Okay, ready? On the count of three, everyone jump together!

notes: Word/particle analysis: じゃあ: then, okay then | いい: i-adjective, okay, ready | １、２の３で: on the count of three | みんな: everyone | 一緒に: together | 飛び跳ねる: to jump, to bounce | わ: feminine sentence-ending particle | よ: sentence-ending particle adding emphasis

japanese: １、２の３、ジャンプ。
notes: Word/particle analysis: １: one | ２: two | の: linking particle used in the counting expression | ３: three | ジャンプ: jump

japanese: 何をやってるんだろ？

meanings.en: I wonder what they're doing?

notes: Word/particle analysis: 何: what | を: object particle | やってる: contracted form of やっている, to be doing | ん: explanatory の | だろ: contraction of だろう, I wonder

japanese: 大成功、パンケーキが落ちて来ました。

meanings.en: A great success! The pancake fell down.

notes: Word/particle analysis: 大成功: great success | パンケーキ: pancake | が: subject particle | 落ちる: to fall | きました: auxiliary indicating movement toward the speaker, came

japanese: ダディーの顔に乗ってるよ。

meanings.en: It's on Daddy's face!

notes: Word/particle analysis: ダディー: Daddy | の: possessive particle | 顔: face | に: particle indicating location | 乗ってる: contracted form of 乗っている, to be on, to be resting on | よ: sentence-ending particle adding emphasis

japanese: ダディーピッグ、シロップ掛ける？

meanings.en: Daddy Pig, do you want some syrup on it?

notes: Word/particle analysis: ダディーピッグ: Daddy Pig | シロップ: syrup | 掛ける: to pour over, to drizzle

japanese: ああ、頼むよ。 /// １、２の３、そーれ！

meanings.en: Yeah, please. /// One, two, three... here we go!

notes: Word/particle analysis: ああ: yes, yeah | 頼む: to ask, to request; here “please” | よ: sentence-ending particle adding emphasis | １: one | ２: two | の: linking particle used in the counting expression | ３: three | そーれ: here goes!, there we go!

japanese: こりゃあ、美味しいね。

meanings.en: This is delicious!

notes: Word/particle analysis: こりゃあ: colloquial これは, this | 美味しい: i-adjective, delicious | ね: sentence-ending particle seeking agreement

japanese: ダディーったら。

meanings.en: Oh, Daddy!

notes: Word/particle analysis: ダディー: Daddy | ったら: particle expressing exasperation or affectionate reproach
